properties.description: Alert when pods enter CrashLoopBackOff state indicating application or configuration errors
properties.query: KubePodInventory | where TimeGenerated > ago(5m) | where PodStatus in ('CrashLoopBackOff', 'Error', 'Init:CrashLoopBackOff') | summarize CrashCount = count() by ClusterName, Namespace, PodName, PodStatus | where CrashCount > 0

properties.description: Alert when containers are killed due to out-of-memory conditions — increase memory limits or investigate memory leak
properties.query: KubePodInventory | where TimeGenerated > ago(10m) | where PodStatus contains 'OOMKilled' or ContainerStatus contains 'OOMKilled' | project TimeGenerated, ClusterName, Namespace, PodName, ContainerName, PodStatus | order by TimeGenerated desc

properties.description: Alert when WAF blocked requests spike > 500% above baseline, indicating possible attack or misconfigured rule
properties.query: AzureDiagnostics | where ResourceType == 'APPLICATIONGATEWAYS' | where OperationName == 'ApplicationGatewayAccess' | where requestUri_s != '/healthz' | where httpStatus_d >= 400 | summarize BlockedCount = count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 5m), Resource | order by BlockedCount desc | where BlockedCount > 100

properties.description: Alert when AKS nodes are in NotReady state for more than 10 minutes
properties.query: KubeNodeInventory | where TimeGenerated > ago(10m) | where Status != 'Ready' | project TimeGenerated, ClusterName, NodeName, Status, Conditions | order by TimeGenerated desc

properties.description: Alert on ImagePullBackOff / ErrImagePull events — indicates ACR connectivity issues or missing images
properties.query: KubePodInventory | where TimeGenerated > ago(10m) | where PodStatus in ('ImagePullBackOff', 'ErrImagePull', 'Init:ImagePullBackOff') | project TimeGenerated, ClusterName, Namespace, PodName, NodeName, PodStatus

properties.description: Alert when KEDA ScaledObject fails to scale — check event source connectivity or ScaledObject configuration
properties.query: KubeEvents | where TimeGenerated > ago(10m) | where Reason in ('FailedScaleUp', 'FailedGetScale', 'FailedResolve') | where EventObject contains 'scaledobject' or EventObject contains 'keda' | project TimeGenerated, ClusterName, Namespace, Name, Reason, Message

properties.description: Alert when cert-manager managed certificates are expiring within 14 days
properties.query: KubeEvents | where TimeGenerated > ago(1d) | where Reason == 'CertExpiring' | project TimeGenerated, ClusterName, Namespace, Name, Message | where Message contains '14 day'

properties.description: Alert on high-severity Microsoft Defender for Containers findings
properties.query: SecurityAlert | where TimeGenerated > ago(1h) | where AlertSeverity == 'High' | where AlertType contains 'Kubernetes' or AlertType contains 'Container' or AlertType contains 'Secret' | project TimeGenerated, AlertDisplayName, AlertSeverity, CompromisedEntity, ExtendedProperties
